final_verdict.label: RECYCLED_FOOTAGE
final_verdict.summary: The footage matches the earliest copy found, published on 2026-08-21 (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcUFQZhvGzS/, date independently fetched per yt-dlp live metadata), before the claimed event date 2026-08-26. Matcher evidence: 35 temporally consistent frame(s), up to 168 inliers, mirrored. This shows the footage was previously published; it does not by itself show the footage is fake or that the claimed event did not happen. Separately, the AI visual clues report 3 unverified observation(s) that clash with the claim (e.g. "Original on-video English captions indicate foreign source clip, with Nepali 'Rasuwa' caption added as overlay", frame ref [7, 40]); these are model observations, not independent evidence and not part of the visual-match proof.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
Dates are UTC calendar dates from the platform. Without an exact timestamp a copy must be dated at least 2 days before the claimed date to count as earlier (time-zone margin: Nepal is UTC+5:45).

texts.en: The earliest copy found of this footage was published on 2026-08-21 on Instagram by Leigh Coates at https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcUFQZhvGzS/, which is before the claimed event date of 2026-08-26. The video was shared as showing "Nepal GLOF" in Nepal on 2026-08-26. Visual matching to the earlier copy shows strong agreement with 35 consistent frames and up to 168 inliers. This proves the footage was already published earlier; it does not by itself prove that no GLOF happened in Nepal.
texts.ne: यस फुटेजको भेटिएको सबैभन्दा पुरानो प्रति 2026-08-21 मा Instagram मा Leigh Coates द्वारा https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcUFQZhvGzS/ मा प्रकाशित भएको थियो, जुन दाबी गरिएको घटना मिति 2026-08-26 भन्दा पहिले हो। यो भिडियो Nepal मा 2026-08-26 मा "Nepal GLOF" देखाएको भन्दै साझा गरिएको थियो। पहिलेको प्रतिसँगको दृश्य तुलना (visual matching) ले 35 वटा मिल्दो फ्रेम र 168 सम्म इनलायरहरूसँग बलियो मेल देखाउँछ। यसले फुटेज पहिले नै प्रकाशित भएको प्रमाणित गर्छ; यसले मात्र Nepal मा GLOF भएको थिएन भन्ने प्रमाणित गर्दैन।
